Title: Aditya and the Family

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Riya - 12 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Anita - 34 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Vimla - 64 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Rishabh - 11 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Riya, Anita and Rishabh stand near him.]

Aditya: "Riya, what's the plan today?"

[Aditya tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Aditya (excited): "Yes, all right."

[Aditya hugs Mother tightly.]

Aditya: "Really?"

[Aditya carries his school bag on his back.]

Rishabh: "Let's see."

[Riya draws a rangoli at the door.]

Riya: "Okay, Rishabh."

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Aditya: "Yes, of course."

[Hailstones start falling.]

Riya: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Aditya: "I really enjoyed today."
